title: Nitrate concentration mediates iron transformation by an iron-oxidizing–reducing bacterium in the Fe(II)–Fe(III) co-existing system
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2941-2954
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00298B, Paper
Rong Peng, Qi Zhu, Shuang Li, Hui Liu
Comamonas terrigena HJ-2, a nitrate-dependent iron oxidizer with Fe(III) reduction ability, drives Fe transformation in Fe(II)–Fe(III) systems via nitrate, which promotes Fe(II) bio-oxidation and alters mineral transformation pathways.
